title: Software-engineering lightning talk
summary: Undergraduate and graduate software-engineering students prepare 15 auto-advancing slides and deliver a five-minute in-class presentation on an assigned topic. AI tools are allowed for writing assessments when students cite AI material, while the timed live delivery requires students to understand and rehearse their work.
